subject: CardioSync evaluation kickoff & scheduling alignment
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@cardiosync.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: CardioSync discovery follow-up — next steps and proposed kickoff

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get an evaluation kicked off with clear success criteria.

Recap (1-sentence each)
- CardioSync wants to accelerate triage for cardiology reports and reduce manual review time by at least 30%.
- Primary data: de-identified ECG reports + metadata (no raw DICOM); volume ~1.2M reports/year, pilot subset ~2k reports.
- Success criteria you called out: 1) extraction accuracy >= 92% for key fields, 2) end-to-end latency < 500ms p95 for inference batch path, 3) stable cost per 1k inferences under the committed bucket.

Proposed evaluation plan (high level)
- 4-week pilot: Week 0 = kickoff + data ingestion; Weeks 1–3 = prompts/evals + model tuning; Week 4 = final report + recommended rollout.
- We'll provide a trial plan and an evaluation rubric (attached). We ask CardioSync to share a 200–500 record prompt set + expected outputs for initial eval.

Scheduling the kickoff
- Can we align on a 60–75 minute kickoff (tech + success criteria + calendar sync)? Proposed windows (all ET):
  • Tue Nov 9 — 11:00–12:15
  • Wed Nov 10 — 09:00–10:15
  • Thu Nov 11 — 14:00–15:15
Please confirm which works or propose 1–2 alternatives.

Pre-kickoff asks
- Share any compliance or procurement contacts (we try to include SRE + procurement on the kickoff).
- A sample of the de-identified report structure and any prompt examples you already use.

Attachments: trial_plan_cardiosync_v1.pdf (draft trial plan), vendor_security_qs.pdf (so we can pre-check compliance asks).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@cardiosync.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CardioSync discovery follow-up — technical notes ahead of kickoff

Thanks — quick technical note ahead of the kickoff: 

- Deployment region: we can host the trial in us-east1 or us-west2. For lower latency to your East Coast clinicians, us-east1 is recommended. Which do you prefer?
- Model variants: initial trial will use two configurations (larger open model + tuned quantized variant) so we can compare extraction precision vs cost.
- Network + security: please provide the list of IPs/ CIDR blocks that need to be whitelisted for the trial. We’ll also need a point of contact for KMS key exchange if you want to use your own KMS.
- Attachments: evaluation_rubric.xlsx (scoring matrix), small_integration_checklist.md (checklist).

I’ve attached a short rubric for how we’ll score field-extraction precision and latency buckets. If there are any additional telemetry hooks you want (e.g., sample trace IDs), flag them now so we can wire them before ingestion.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Marcus
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
